claims.claim: A Pension Credit claimant must have reached State Pension age.
claims.quote: You’ll be eligible if either: you and your partner have both reached State Pension age one of you is getting Housing Benefit for people over State Pension age
claims.note: The general age rule has a mixed-age couple exception when one partner gets Housing Benefit for people over State Pension age.

claims.quote: The State Pension age for men and women will now increase to 67 between 2026 and 2028.
claims.note: The age is rising in stages during 2026–2028, so it is not uniformly 66 now.
